cardiac_patients.sql
1-- @name: CardiacPatients
2-- @relatedDependency: http://acme.org/ViewDefinition/conditions
3-- @relatedDependency: http://acme.org/ValueSet/cvd|2026 as cvd_codes
4-- @param: since date
5SELECT conditions.patient_id, conditions.code
6FROM conditions
7WHERE conditions.onset >= :since
8  AND EXISTS (
9    SELECT 1 FROM cvd_codes
10    WHERE cvd_codes.system = conditions.system
11      AND cvd_codes.code = conditions.code
12  )
